pairs.why: A's dome ribs and ladder are thin, crisp lines with fewer small edges, while B has busier ribs, pipes, rocks and stars, though both have similar soft outer edges.
A's coral has finer dots and a soft edge against the background, similar to the real card, while B has a glowing, bright rim with heavy, glossy edges.
B's glove edges are soft and the background stripes are low-contrast, closer to the real cards, while A has crisper stripe edges and more plank seams.
A's window frames are thin and precise, with a soft edge between the booth and background, while B has a bright halo glow around the hero.
Both ropes have similar soft outer edges and no drawn outlines, so linework gives no reason to choose.
A has the thinner window bars and no glow around the booth, while B has a halo glow behind the hero and a busier crown pattern.
A's board squares and stool edges are fairly crisp but not outlined, with a slightly lower background edge density than B.
B's edges are softer overall, while A's plank seams and stripe edges are crisper, with more edges in the background.
